reasons: Couldn't confirm this is the same padlock. Photo B is not the same physical padlock as Photo A. Although both are dark rusted iron with a thick arched shackle, the body design is completely different. Photo A has an ornate shaped body with side notches, two lower round holes and upper openings, a central vertical plate and a rivet detail, and a lobed/pointed bottom. Photo B has a plain solid rectangular block body with no holes, notches, or central plate and a flat bottom. The holes that go through A would be visible from the back, but B shows solid metal. Outline and details do not match.
